summary: Retain later-line RFI and Submittal headings from generically named PDF evidence in bounded FTS source comparisons.
decision_refs: The active objective requires accurate and adaptable project questions across RFI, Submittal and Email content
Offline reproductions proved that the multiline source classifier accepted later RFI/Submittal headings while the FTS family filters rejected them
Aligning existing bounded filters avoids fuzzy identifiers, a second index, dependency or parser change
approval_evidence: The persistent objective authorizes bounded accuracy and adaptability improvements to the existing file-grounded question flow.
known_limitations: Only the existing exact line-leading workflow headings are added to the FTS prefilter; indented, OCR-damaged or prose-only references are not inferred.
The local ranker and source classifier still decide the final source family, so an inline reference does not become an RFI or Submittal merely because the prefilter found text.
The change affects local evidence retrieval only and does not add parsing, OCR, model calls or contractual authority rules.
